name: Shoal Halfling
traits: Small Humanoid with the Aquatic and Halfling subtypes. +2 Dexterity, −2 Strength. Land speed 20 ft. and swim speed 20 ft. LA +0.
Small size gives +1 AC and attack rolls, +4 Hide, and three-quarters of normal carrying capacity. The shoal halfling uses Small weapons.
Amphibious (Ex). Breathes air and water equally.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks for special actions or hazards. Take 10 even when distracted or endangered. A swimming run follows a straight line.
+1 racial on all saving throws. A +2 morale bonus on saves against fear stacks with the racial save bonus. The +2 racial bonus on Listen checks is retained.
The variant loses the halfling racial +1 on attack rolls with thrown weapons and slings and the racial +2 on Climb, Jump, and Move Silently. The Small size attack bonus still applies.
Common and Halfling are automatic. Bonus languages are Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, and Orc. Favored class Rogue.
